Title: The Corbomite Maneuver
Description: After the Enterprise is forced to destroy a dangerous marker buoy~ a gigantic alien ship arrives to capture and condemn the crew as trespassers.
Justification: A starting place for the original series that highliughts the character dynamics of the main trio as they confront an anomaly in space.

Title: Balance of Terror
Description: The Enterprise must decide on its response when a Romulan ship makes a destructively hostile armed probe of Federation territory.
Justification: The distinctive suspenseful and dramatic submarine warfare (rather than all-out combat) is spotlighted here.

Title: The City on the Edge of Forever
Description: When a temporarily insane Dr. McCoy accidentally changes history and destroys his time~ Kirk and Spock follow him to prevent the disaster~ but the price to do so is high.
Justification: A favorite episode that features the original series trop of time travel to pose a moral dilemma.

Title: The Doomsday Machine
Description: The USS Enterprise encounters the wrecked USS Constellation and its distraught commodore who~s determined to stop the giant planet-destroying robot ship that killed his crew.

Title: The Menagerie
Description: Spock kidnaps the disabled Capt. Pike~ hijacks the Enterprise~ and then surrenders for court martial. At Spock~s court martial~ he explains himself with mysterious footage about when Capt. Pike was kidnapped by powerful illusion casting aliens.

Title: Yesterday’s Enterprise
Description: The Enterprise C enters the Enterprise D~s time and space continuum~ where they find Picard and crew in a constant state of war with the Klingons~ and only Guinan knows it.
Justification: A great starting point to illustrates the series~ excellent production~ special effects~ and character efforts in confronting an anomoly in space. Take this chance to familiarize yourself with the characters and the science fiction approach to identifying and resolving science fiction conflicts.

Title: The Measure of a Man
Description: When Data resigns his commission rather than be dismantled for examination by an inadequately skilled scientist~ a formal hearing is convened to determine whether Data is considered property without rights or is a sentient being.
Justification: Demonstrates The Next Generation~s penchant for moral dilemas and the skill of the main cast in evaluating the situation with the help of a classic Picard speech.

Title: The Best of Both Worlds
Description: Responding to a distress call on one of the Federation~s outer-most colonies~ the Enterprise arrives...only to find a big hole in the ground where the town used to be~ and discovers the Borg are behind the attack.
Justification: A staple in television history that raised the stakes to an unimaginable height with this two-parter. The conflict explores character dynamics while also posing a battlke in space executed using TNG logic.

Title: The Inner Light
Description: Picard awakes to find himself living in a small village where he is a well-known member of the community who is suffering from a delusion of being a starship captain.
Justification: Demonstrates how the series uses science fiction concepts and dilemas to heighten character traits with this deeply intimate Picard-focused episode.

Title: Who Watches The Watchers
Description: A proto-Vulcan culture worships Captain Picard and prepares to offer Counselor Troi as a sacrifice.
Justification: Crystalizes the moral code that the crew of the Next Generation crew is bound to navigate.

Title: Emmisary
Description: When the troubled Commander Sisko takes command of a surrendered space station~ he learns that it borders a unique stable wormhole.

Title: The Visitor
Description: Melanie~ an aspiring writer~ wants to know why Jake Sisko stopped writing at 40. Jake tells how his father died in an accident and then suddenly reappeared.

Title: Sacrifice of Angels
Description: The Federation attacks DS9 in hopes of keeping the mine field at the wormhole intact~ while the Dominion waits entrance to the Alpha Quadrant from the other side.

Title: Blink of an Eye
Description: Voyager becomes trapped in orbit of a planet where time passes rapidly~ days within seconds~ and enters the mythos of its indigenous people.

Title: Year of Hell
Description: Voyager comes across a Krenim timeship that's wiping whole species from existence to change the existing timeline.

Title: The Wrath of Kahn
Description: With the assistance of the Enterprise crew~ Admiral Kirk must stop an old nemesis~ Khan Noonien Singh~ from using the life-generating Genesis Device as the ultimate weapon.

Title: The Voyage Home
Description: To save Earth from an alien probe~ Admiral James T. Kirk and his fugitive crew go back in time to San Francisco in 1986 to retrieve the only beings who can communicate with it: humpback whales.

Title: First Contact
Description: The Borg travel back in time intent on preventing Earth's first contact with an alien species. Captain Picard and his crew pursue them to ensure that Zefram Cochrane makes his maiden flight reaching warp speed.

Title: Star Trek
Description: The brash James T. Kirk tries to live up to his father's legacy with Mr. Spock keeping him in check as a vengeful Romulan from the future creates black holes to destroy the Federation one planet at a time.

Title: The Motion Picture
Description: When an alien spacecraft of enormous power is spotted approaching Earth~ Admiral James T. Kirk resumes command of the overhauled USS Enterprise in order to intercept it.
